subject: Medicore: data residency, audit rights & on-prem constraints — escalation
messages:
From: Claire Rios <claire.rios@medicore.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Dan Li <dan.li@medicore.com>, procurement@medicore.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Residency & audit needs for pilot — initial ask

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the demo earlier — Medicore is keen on a pilot. Before we proceed, procurement flagged three hard requirements we need reflected in contractual terms:

- Data residency: production data must reside in our US-only VPC region and not replicate outside our tenancy.
- Audit rights: Medicore auditors must be able to run an annual access and configuration audit (reasonable notice) and receive export logs (tokens redacted).
- Deployment constraint: if there's any egress or third-party subprocessors, they must be enumerated; we need an option for an on-prem appliance if the managed VPC can't meet an internal HSM requirement.

Also, can you confirm pricing flexibility for a 24-month committed pilot (we're targeting ~20M tokens/month)? Procurement will be pushing for a one-time onboarding credit and an initial discount.

I'll attach our Q&A and procurement checklist.

Thanks,
Claire
Procurement Lead | Medicore Health

Attachments: Medicore_QnA.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Claire Rios <claire.rios@medicore.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Residency & audit needs for pilot — initial ask

Claire,

Appreciate the detail — this is a use case we see in regulated health customers. Quick answers up front:

- Residency: we can support a dedicated VPC with US-only region pinning and customer-managed VPC peering. Final technical CIDR/peering details would be in the SOW.
- Audit rights: we can provide exported logs (access, config, audit events) with token redaction and an annual auditor window. Need to confirm retention window and exact fields you need.
- On-prem/HSM: we offer a Private on-prem package but it requires additional workstreams (networking, install window). We can scope a detachable on-prem HSM integration, but that will be a Professional Services line item.

On pricing: if Medicore commits to 24 months at 20M tokens/mo, we can consider a one-time onboarding credit and a term discount. I need executive approval for discounts >15% or carveouts on audit SLA. Looping in Vivek (head of commercial) and Nikhil (product/security) to assess risk and acceptance criteria.

I'll follow up with a concise summary for Deal Desk and attach a proposed SOW draft.

—Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Proposed_SOW_v3.docx (draft)

From: Dan Li <dan.li@medicore.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, Claire Rios <claire.rios@medicore.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Residency & audit needs for pilot — initial ask

Olga — thanks. Two clarifications from our security team:

1) Audit exports must include a per-user action log for 12 months. Full exports as CSV or S3 dump.
2) If Redwood cannot do HSM-backed keys in the VPC model, Medicore will require either (a) on-prem appliance or (b) key escrow with HSM in our control.

Procurement would like a term sheet that calls out these items specifically and a proposed discount model (we were expecting 20% off list for the pilot).

Dan
CISO (acting) | Medicore Health

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Medicore residency & audit needs — exec signoff request

Team — forwarding Medicore's asks. TL;DR summary and recommended concessions:

- Residency: Dedicated US-only VPC (standard for Redwood Private). No replication outside region; we can commit in SOW. Low risk.
- Audit exports: Provide 12 months of per-user action logs + weekly S3 exports. Redaction of tokens will be handled via our export pipeline; product can confirm fields. Medium risk but implementable.
- HSM/on-prem: Two options: (A) deploy Redwood Private in their VPC with BYOK/HSM integration (we need 4–6 weeks of work), or (B) on-prem appliance (significant engineering + PS). Recommend option A with a PS SOW for HSM integration.

Commercial ask: Medicore requests 20% discount + one-time onboarding credit. Our standard threshold for discount authority:
- Olga (rep): up to 10% without exec signoff
- Vivek/Commercial: up to 15% with manager approval
- >15% requires exec (Laura) or Deal Desk signoff

Recommendation: Approve 18% discount for a 24-month commit at 20M tokens/mo, conditional on:
1) SOW explicitly limits audit scope to exported logs (no remote code inspection).
2) PS engagement for HSM/BYOK billed separately and limited to agreed milestones.
3) Medicore signs a 24-month MRC with minimum committed spend.

Rationale: Captures the enterprise while protecting platform risk and PS revenue. Please advise if you approve or want alternate terms. Attaching a redline of the term sheet.

—Olga

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Medicore residency & audit needs — exec signoff request

Thanks Olga — good summary. I approve moving forward with the recommended commercial compromise but request the following firm conditions before signoff:

1) Discount capped at 18% only if Medicore signs the 24-month minimum commitment and accepts our standard outage SLA and liability caps.
2) Audit scope must be limited to exported logs and a single yearly on-site/remote audit session (no continuous access). Any additional audit windows billed at our PS rate.
3) HSM integration must be scoped as a separate PS project with defined acceptance criteria; Redwood will not provide source-level access.

If Laura (legal/exec signoff) concurs with these boundaries, we can offer the 18% and a one-time onboarding credit equal to 2 weeks of base consumption. Please escalate to Laura for final exec signoff on the >15% discount.

—Vivek
Head of Commercial | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: Claire Rios <claire.rios@medicore.com>, Dan Li <dan.li@medicore.com>, procurement@medicore.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Medicore residency & audit needs — exec approval (final)

Team / Medicore,

After review with Legal and Finance, Redwood will approve the following commercial and contractual package for Medicore Health:

- Commercial: 18% term discount for a 24-month committed contract at 20M tokens/mo. One-time onboarding credit equal to two weeks of expected base consumption.
- Residency: Dedicated US-only VPC with explicit SOW language prohibiting data replication outside the customer's tenancy.
- Audit: Provide 12 months of per-user action logs and an annual auditor window (one remote or on-site session). Audit exports delivered via S3; token redaction process documented in SOW. Any additional audit requests invoiced at standard PS rates.
- HSM/Key control: BYOK/HSM integration in their VPC scoped as PS (4–6 week project); on-prem appliance discussed as higher-cost alternative and not part of this SOW.
- Limitations: No source code access; no continuous live access to internal host systems. SOW to include acceptance criteria and PS milestone-based payments.

Conditions: Medicore must sign the term sheet and PS SOWs within 30 days; Finance reserves the right to rescind discount if commitment not executed.

Olga — please send the redlined term sheet and updated SOW to Medicore (cc'd) and coordinate signatures via DocuSign. Once signed, instruct Billing to apply the onboarding credit.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Signed_Term_Sheet_stub.pdf (placeholder)
